02a4df5f9777d66c5d1060a942e10e18684cf3f9.summary: Zscaler ThreatLabz analyses exploitation of CVE-2026-88771, a critical unauthenticated remote code execution flaw in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway that Citrix disclosed on 27 September 2026. Attackers poisoned appliance logs with a forged failure record that a privileged maintenance script later executed, then tried to deploy web shells and a FreeBSD implant. The report notes overlap with StyleSmuggler (CVE-2026-75650) infrastructure but says this does not establish threat actor attribution.

02e61990f3e053afd9e6aaa3b1a6fd466e46fbd3.summary: Breakglass Intelligence reports on a Kimsuky command-and-control server with directory listing enabled, serving a three-stage kill chain that starts from a CHM help file disguised as API documentation. The stages cover system reconnaissance with scheduled-task persistence, a PowerShell bridge, and a keylogger with clipboard monitoring and timed exfiltration. The report maps about 79 domains across five IPs on Korean and US VPS providers and free dynamic DNS services, including Naver and tax-themed phishing lures aimed at South Korean users.
